walkthrough:
Adjacent rectangle sides are perpendicular base and height.
Verify the right angle at vertex $B$:
$$m_{AB} = \dfrac{2 - 0}{6 - 0} = \dfrac{1}{3}$$
$$m_{BC} = \dfrac{5 - 2}{5 - 6} = \dfrac{3}{-1} = -3$$
$$m_{AB} \times m_{BC} = \dfrac{1}{3} \times (-3) = -1 \implies \angle ABC = 90^\circ$$

Calculate side lengths and rectangle area:
$$AB = \sqrt{6^2 + 2^2} = \sqrt{40} = 2\sqrt{10}$$
$$BC = \sqrt{(5 - 6)^2 + (5 - 2)^2} = \sqrt{1 + 9} = \sqrt{10}$$
$$\text{Area} = AB \times BC = 2\sqrt{10} \times \sqrt{10} = 20$$
